args.title: Halvorsen Supply newsletter summary — freight pricing
args.body:
• Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest newsletter highlights "Freight pricing this quarter" and links to their blog article on the topic.
• Article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
